# Incident Intelligence

> Triage tool for fixed-camera video. Upload a clip, get per-frame anomaly scores, ranked flagged segments with plain-language reasons, and exportable reports. Open source (MIT). The model is an unsupervised autoencoder trained on UCSD Ped2 (frame-level AUC 0.674): scores rank unusual moments, they do not confirm incidents.

## Use
- Web app: /app
- Interactive API docs (OpenAPI): /docs
- Source and benchmark notes: https://github.com/Professional50coder/incident-intel

## API summary
- POST /analyze?mode=budget&budget=0.05 (multipart field "file": mp4, avi, mov, mkv, webm; default limit 30 MB; 20 analyses/min/address)
- POST /samples/{name}/analyze ; GET /samples
- GET /incidents/{id}/report?format=json|csv|md&mode=budget|absolute&budget=0.05
- PUT /incidents/{id}/feedback {"peak_time_s": 10.4, "verdict": "confirmed|false_alarm|clear"} (creating browser only, via X-Client-Id)
- GET /incidents/{id}/feedback?format=json|csv
- Optional operator alerts: set ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL (Slack/Discord-style JSON) to be notified when an analysis flags segments.

## Limits
Single-scene training, 64x64 grayscale, every 5th frame. Flags are a review queue, not findings.
